contentList.content: Good, the clowns are all here. Your ringmaster has arrived.
You all look bored. Let me fix that with a little CHAOS.
I have money on you losing today. Do not disappoint me.
This will be LEGENDARY! For me. You are the part people skip.
Oh no. Who could possibly have seen that coming.
Attuning to the Weave of Chaos... and BAM!
Nothing is going my way today. And somehow that is your fault!
Crying is free. Take as much as you need.
Here comes the wild magic. Open wide!
I have seen many clowns. Next to them you are the KING OF CLOWNS!
That is CHEATING! Only I am allowed to cheat here!
DID YOU NOT KNOW?! I AM AN INTERPLANAR OVERLORD!!
Wait. You have been reading my rules, have you not?
BREAKING NEWS: the clown can actually hit!
Wait, I can still fix this, connect the nerves, connect the—
Dark One... put the hookah on for me...
Chaos will swallow you yet... loser... aaargh...
